channel.title: Mohammadreza Nobahari · Writing
channel.description: Notes on network security, Python automation and systems thinking.

item.title: FortiGate Debug Flow: A Practical Cheat Sheet
item.description: "The firewall is blocking it" is a guess. Debug flow turns it into a fact. Here's the exact command sequence I use, how to read the output, and the five messages that explain 90% of dropped traffic.

item.title: Subnetting in Your Head: The Block-Size Method
item.description: You don't need a calculator to subnet. One small table and one division get you the network, broadcast and host range of any IPv4 address in under ten seconds. Here's the method I teach, with worked examples.

item.title: The Bridge: Why Every Developer Should Understand Packet Flow
item.description: Developers who ignore networking build fragile apps. Network engineers who ignore code repeat manual work forever. This is the bridge: what actually happens between "fetch()" and the server, and how to debug it when it breaks.

item.title: Automating FortiGate Policies with Python
item.description: Clicking through the GUI for one rule is fine. For fifty rules across three sites it's how mistakes happen. Here's how to treat firewall policies as data: describe them in a file, validate them with Python and push them through the FortiOS REST API, safely.

item.title: Learn Like a Gamer, Work Like a Pro
item.description: Games taught me persistence, pattern recognition and systems thinking long before I touched a CLI. Here's how to turn the way gamers learn into a practical strategy for getting good at networking and security.

item.title: Building a Threat Intelligence Dashboard with Python
item.description: Exported firewall logs are thousands of lines nobody reads. With about 80 lines of standard-library Python you can parse them, score suspicious behaviour and produce an HTML report your team will actually open in the weekly security meeting.
